confidence_notes: The RBA rate comes from a search of the RBA site, which showed 0.6720 USD per AUD for 2026-11-18. I did not open the RBA page directly. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors come from one aggregate search that returned Numbeo-based figures (Expatica, June 2026) and an expat guide (March 2026). Those figures were about $25 for an inexpensive meal, about $100-105 for a mid-range meal for two, about $5 for a cappuccino and about $6 for a domestic draft beer. The search found no cocktail or by-the-glass wine prices. I set the cocktail at roughly 2.3 times the draft beer price and the wine glass at roughly 2.2 times, which is a general US pattern and not a local measurement. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against any listings. Atlanta hostel supply is thin, so the hostel figures are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other large US Southern and Sun Belt cities such as Nashville, Miami and Dallas. Atlanta restaurant prices appear slightly below New York City and above the US average.
